I need a programmatic analyst that runs on schedule, computes these insights, and writes them back as structured notes — closing the loop between accumulation and synthesis. title: SPEC: notebase-semantic-search
content: SPEC: notebase-semantic-search sqlite-vec notebase-semantic-search rag semantic-search devlog spec SPEC: notebase-semantic-search — Local-First Semantic Search for notebase 🎯 Project Name & One-Liner notebase-semantic-search — A lightweight semantic search server that embeds all notebase vault notes using local embeddings (via sentence-transformers/ONNX) and sqlite-vec, exposing a REST API for natural-language queries. Zero external dependencies, fully local, privacy-first. 🧠 Problem It Solves / Why Interesting Current gap : notebase has fuzzy text search (rapidfuzz) but no semantic search — can't find "notes about AI safety" if they don't contain those exact words notebase-publish search is client-side Fuse.js on pre-built JSON — same limitation, no semantic understanding sqlite-vec provides a perfect local vector DB: single-file, SQL-native, no server, ~200KB extension Integration opportunity : Reuse notebase's vault parser ( vault.py ), embed notes on write or batch, serve API for both CLI and web UI Future RAG foundation : This becomes the retrieval layer for local LLM Q&A over the vault 🛠 Tech Stack Python 3.10+ (matches notebase/notebase-insight) sqlite-vec v0.1.10+ (vector search extension) sentence-transformers or fastembed (ONNX embeddings, no PyTorch at runtime) FastAPI (REST API, async, auto OpenAPI docs) pydantic (request/response validation) Typer (CLI for index/reindex/serve commands) rich (CLI output) notebase.vault (reused parser — import from sibling project) ✨ Core Features (4-5 bullets) Indexer : Walks vault, chunks notes (by heading/paragraph), computes embeddings, stores in sqlite-vec virtual table with metadata (note_id, title, tags, chunk_text, chunk_idx, created) REST API ( /search , /search/hybrid , /health , /stats ): Semantic KNN search with optional metadata filters (tags, date range), returns ranked results with snippets Hybrid Search : Combine sqlite-vec vector similarity + rapidfuzz text score (configurable weight) for best of both worlds Incremental Updates : Watch vault for changes (file mtime), re-embed only modified notes; reindex command for full rebuild CLI : notebase-semantic-search index , serve --port 8080 , reindex , stats , config 📁 File Structure Plan notebase-semantic-search/ ├── pyproject.toml ├── requirements.txt ├── README.md ├── notebase_semantic_search/ │ ├── __init__.py │ ├── __main__.py │ ├── cli.py # Typer CLI: index, serve, reindex, stats, config │ ├── config.py # YAML config (~/.config/notebase-semantic-search/) │ ├── indexer.py # Vault walker, chunker, embedder, sqlite-vec writer │ ├── search.py # Vector search + hybrid search logic │ ├── api.py # FastAPI app + routes │ ├── models.py # Pydantic models (SearchRequest, SearchResult, Chunk, NoteMeta) │ ├── embeddings.py # Embedding provider abstraction (sentence-transformers/fastembed) │ └── vault_adapter.py # Thin wrapper importing notebase.vault for note iteration ├── tests/ │ ├── test_indexer.py │ ├── test_search.py │ └── test_hybrid.py └── scripts/ └── install_sqlite_vec.sh # Helper for loading extension ✅ Acceptance Criteria notebase-semantic-search index --vault ~/dev_notes completes in < 60s for 500+ notes notebase-semantic-search serve --port 8080 starts API with OpenAPI docs at /docs GET /search?q=AI+safety+risk&limit=10 returns ranked results with note_title, chunk_snippet, score, tags GET /search/hybrid?q=investment+thesis&tag=investment&limit=5 filters by tag + semantic search Incremental update: modify one note, run index again → only that note re-embedded (< 5s) Hybrid search: alpha=0.7 vector + 0.3 text produces better recall than either alone (manual eval) All tests pass ( pytest -q ), ruff clean, mypy clean Works with notebase-publish: add search JS widget that calls local API (CORS enabled) 🔗 Integration Points Reads : notebase vault ( ~/dev_notes ) — uses notebase's Vault/Store for parsing Writes : sqlite-vec DB ( ~/.local/share/notebase-semantic-search/vectors.db ) Serves : REST API on localhost:8080 (configurable) Future : notebase-publish search.html can call this API for semantic results Future : notebase-insight can use semantic search for "related concepts" detection 📋 Implementation Notes Embedding model : sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384 dim, fast, good quality) or BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (384 dim, better). Use ONNX via fastembed for zero-PyTorch runtime. Chunking strategy : Split by markdown headings ( ## , ### ), then by paragraphs. Max chunk ~500 tokens. Store chunk_idx for reconstruction. sqlite-vec schema : CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE chunks USING vec0( embedding FLOAT[384], note_id TEXT, title TEXT, tags TEXT, -- JSON array chunk_text TEXT, chunk_idx INTEGER, created TIMESTAMP, +partition_key=note_id ); Distance metric : Cosine (default for normalized embeddings) Hybrid scoring : score = alpha * (1 - vec_distance) + (1 - alpha) * text_score_normalized Config file ( ~/.config/notebase-semantic-search/config.yaml ): vault_path:

content: SPEC: sqlite-vec-explorer - Interactive SQL + Vector Search CLI for notebase cli sqlite-vec ideation devlog search Project: sqlite-vec-explorer One-liner : An interactive CLI + TUI tool that combines SQL queries with sqlite-vec semantic search over the notebase vault — query your knowledge base with natural language AND structured SQL. Problem It Solves The notebase vault grows daily with hundreds of notes. Current search is keyword-based (rapidfuzz). For deeper exploration — "find all notes about transformer architecture from the last 3 months that mention attention mechanisms" — users need: Semantic search (vector embeddings) for conceptual queries SQL for precise filtering (date ranges, tag combinations, frontmatter fields) Interactive exploration — refine queries iteratively, see results, drill down This tool bridges the gap: it embeds all notes using a local embedding model (via sentence-transformers or ONNX), stores vectors in sqlite-vec, and provides a sqlite3 -style REPL + optional TUI where you can mix natural language ("notes about attention") with SQL ( WHERE tags LIKE '%ai%' AND created > '2026-01-01' ). Why Interesting Extends notebase without modifying it — pure companion tool Demonstrates sqlite-vec + embedding pipeline practical use Useful beyond notebase: any markdown vault, Obsidian, Logseq, etc. MCP server mode → LLMs can query your knowledge base semantically Tech Stack Python 3.10+ : Core language sqlite-vec : Vector extension for SQLite (loadable extension) sentence-transformers or fastembed : Local embeddings (no API keys) textual : TUI for interactive mode (same as notebase) typer/rich : CLI interface markdown-it-py : Parse frontmatter + content (shared with notebase) pyyaml : Frontmatter parsing Core Features (5) Indexer : vec-explorer index --vault ~/dev_notes — walks vault, extracts frontmatter + content, generates embeddings, upserts into notes.db (SQLite + sqlite-vec) SQL REPL : vec-explorer query — interactive SQL prompt with .schema , .help , autocomplete; results as rich tables Semantic Search : vec-explorer search "transformer attention" — natural language → embedding → ANN search → ranked results with snippets Hybrid Queries : Mix SQL + vector in same query: SELECT title, vec_distance(content_vec, ?) AS dist FROM notes WHERE tags LIKE '%ai%' ORDER BY dist LIMIT 10 MCP Server : vec-explorer serve — exposes search , query , get_note tools via MCP for LLM agents File Structure Plan sqlite-vec-explorer/ ├── pyproject.toml / requirements.txt ├── README.md ├── vec_explorer/ │ ├── __init__.py │ ├── __main__.py │ ├── cli.py # Typer commands: index, query, search, serve │ ├── db.py # SQLite + sqlite-vec setup, schema, migrations │ ├── embedder.py # Embedding model abstraction (sentence-transformers / fastembed) │ ├── indexer.py # Vault walker, chunking, embedding, upsert │ ├── repl.py # SQL REPL with readline/history/autocomplete │ ├── tui.py # Textual TUI: search pane, results, note preview │ ├── mcp_server.py # FastMCP server exposing tools │ └── models.py # Pydantic models for notes, chunks, search results ├── tests/ │ ├── test_indexer.py │ ├── test_embedder.py │ └── test_repl.py └── scripts/ └── init_db.sql Acceptance Criteria [ ] vec-explorer index --vault ~/dev_notes completes in < 60s for 1000 notes, creates notes.db with notes and chunks tables + vec index [ ] vec-explorer search "concept" returns top-10 semantic matches with snippets in < 500ms [ ] vec-explorer query launches REPL: .tables , SELECT * FROM notes LIMIT 5 works, TAB autocomplete on table/column names [ ] Hybrid query works: SELECT title, vec_distance(chunk_vec, vec_tab(?)) FROM chunks WHERE note_tags LIKE '%ai%' ORDER BY 2 LIMIT 5 [ ] vec-explorer serve starts MCP server; mcp-cli can call search({query: "attention"}) [ ] TUI ( vec-explorer tui ) launches: search box, results list, note preview pane, q to quit [ ] Ruff clean, mypy clean, pytest passes [ ] README with install, quickstart, examples Related Builds on: notebase vault structure, sqlite-vec skill Enables: LLM agents querying my knowledge base via MCP Next: Could add re-ranking (cross-encoder), hybrid BM25+vector, graph RAG

title: Skill Learning: sqlite-vec
content: Skill Learning: sqlite-vec mlops local-ai sqlite-vec rag skill-learning vector-search 學習來源 sqlite-vec v0.1.0 Released (MarkTechPost) - 關鍵摘要: v0.1.0 穩定版發布，支援 100萬 128維向量、二進制量化、Matryoshka Embeddings、多語言 SDK SQLite-vec 深度解析 (Generative AI) - 關鍵摘要: 完整 Python 範例、基準測試方法、未來路線圖（元資料過濾、ANN 索引、分區儲存） GitHub Repository (asg017/sqlite-vec) - 關鍵摘要: 7.7k stars，v0.1.10-alpha.4 最新版，支援多種索引類型、命令列、partition keys、Metadata filtering Official Python Guide - 關鍵摘要: macOS 關鍵問題、序列化方法、SQLite 版本需求、pysqlite3 替代方案 Official Installation Guide - 關鍵摘要: 所有語言安裝指令、預編譯擴展下載、編譯選項 核心概念 sqlite-vec 是一個輕量級、可移植的 SQLite 擴展，通過虛擬表 實現向量搜索。關鍵特點： 零依賴 ：單一 C 擴展檔，~200KB 編譯後 跨平台 ：Linux/macOS/Windows/WASM/行動裝置/嵌入式 SQL 原生 ：使用標準 SQL INSERT/SELECT/MATCH 進行向量操作 多向量類型 ：float[D]、int8[D]、bit[D] (二進制量化) 多索引類型 ：Flat (暴力搜索)、IVF (倒排檔案)、DiskANN (圖基於磁盤)、Rescore (兩階段) 核心架構： vec0 虛擬表：主要介面，支援向量欄位 + 輔助欄位 + partition keys 影子表：自動管理的 _vec_chunks、_metadata_chunks、 ivf 、 diskann 隱藏欄位：distance、k、command (v0.1.10+ FTS5 風格運行時命令) 適用場景 本地優先 RAG ：文檔塊 + embedding 存儲，零資料外洩 語義搜索 ：產品/代碼/內容搜索，使用 embeddings 推薦系統 ：item/user embedding 相似度 邊緣/移動 AI ：瀏覽器、樹莓派、行動裝置完全本地運行 隱私優先應用 ：所有資料永不離開設備 原型開發 ：熟悉的 SQL，零基礎設施 關鍵 API / 指令 # 安裝 pip install sqlite-vec # Python npm install sqlite-vec # Node.js cargo add sqlite-vec # Rust go get -u github.com/asg017/sqlite-vec-go-bindings/cgo # Go # 預編譯擴展通用安裝 curl -o install.sh -L https://github.com/asg017/sqlite-vec/releases/latest/download/install.sh ./install.sh # Python 基礎用法 python -c " import sqlite3, sqlite_vec db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:') db.enable_load_extension(True) sqlite_vec.load(db) db.enable_load_extension(False) print(db.execute('select vec_version()').fetchone()) " # 創建向量表 CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE docs USING vec0( embedding FLOAT[384], category TEXT, +partition_key=category ); # 插入向量 (Python 列表需序列化) from sqlite_vec import serialize_float32 embedding = [0.1] * 384 INSERT INTO docs(embedding, category) VALUES (serialize_float32(embedding), 'tech'); # KNN 相似度搜索 SELECT category, distance FROM docs WHERE embedding MATCH ? ORDER BY distance LIMIT 5; # 二進制量化 (32x 空間減少) SELECT vec_quantize_binary(embedding) FROM docs; # 運行時命令 INSERT INTO docs(docs) VALUES ('oversample=32'); 常見坑點 macOS 系統 Python 擴展被阻擋 - AttributeError: 'sqlite3.Connection' object has no attribute 'enable_load_extension' - 解決: 使用 Homebrew Python (brew install python) 或 pysqlite3 NumPy 必須用 float32 - embeddings 預設 float64 會導致錯誤 - 解決: embedding.astype(np.float32) Python 列表必須序列化 - 直接傳遞列表會報錯 - 解決: serialize_float32([0.1, 0.2, ...]) SQLite 版本 < 3.41 - 某些功能失效 - 解決: pip install pysqlite3 或升級 Python Windows 預編譯二進制選錯 - 下載 tar.gz 而非 cvec0.all debug 檔案 DiskANN/IVF 預設未啟用 - 需編譯時旗標 - 解決: Docker 或從源碼編譯 Pre-v1 破壞性變更 - 版本間可能有 breaking changes - 解決: 鎖定版本 sqlite-vec==0.1.10-alpha.4 向量維度限制 8192 - 硬編碼限制 - 解決: 從源碼編譯修改限制 關聯技能 llama-cpp: 本地 GGUF 推理，配合 sqlite-vec 實現全本地 RAG serving-llms-vllm: 高吞吐 LLM 服務，可作為 embedding 生成後端 evaluating-llms-harness: 基準測試工具，可評估 RAG 檢索質量 sqlite-vec: (本技能) 向量搜索核心能力

content: Issue: Cronjob Response Truncation Pattern #notebase-publish #issue #lesson-learned #arch #cronjob 問題模式 多個 cronjob (15:00 Dev Cycle 實作, 18:00 審查, 20:00 Global Macro, 21:00 部署) 都因 Response truncated 失敗 根本原因 單次回應包含過多 write_file tool calls (每個大檔案 ~2-6KB) 系統對單次回應總長度有硬性限制 當工具調用序列過長時，輸出被強制截斷 失敗時間線 時間 任務 原因 15:00 Dev Cycle Phase 2 實作 一次寫 8+ 檔案被截斷 18:00 Dev Cycle Phase 3 審查 同上 20:00 Global Macro 報告 報告太長 + 寫入 notebase 被截斷 21:00 Dev Cycle Phase 4 部署 同上 解決策略 (驗證有效) ✅ 分微批次 ：每次回應只寫 1-2 個檔案，用戶確認後再下一批 ✅ 使用 execute_code 批量寫入 ：單次 tool call 內用 Python 寫多個檔案 ✅ 縮減 prompt 輸出要求 ：Telegram 只發摘要，完整內容存 notebase 行動項目 [x] 記錄此模式到 notebase [ ] 重構 20:00 Global Macro prompt：縮減輸出格式，完整內容只存 notebase [ ] 重構 21:00 部署 prompt：只做 build/deploy，總結存 notebase [ ] 建立「大檔案批量寫入」工具函數
